settingsEnabledDesc: When off, no mouse listeners or overlay are attached.
settingsSuppressionKeyDesc: Hold this key to bypass gestures for one right-click.
settingsActivationDistanceDesc: Movement required to transition from PENDING to TRACKING.
settingsTimeoutMsDesc: Maximum gesture duration before auto-cancel (0 = no timeout).
settingsSampleDistanceDesc: Distance between resampled points on the gesture path.
settingsSimplifyToleranceDesc: RDP tolerance — maximum perpendicular deviation kept.
settingsMinimumSegmentLengthDesc: Segments shorter than this are merged away.
settingsTurnAngleThresholdDesc: Heading change required to start a new direction segment.
settingsMaximumSegmentsDesc: Gestures exceeding this are rejected (not truncated).
settingsShowTrailDesc: Draw the mouse trail on a Canvas overlay.
settingsShowHintDesc: Show the live direction sequence and command label.
settingsLineWidthDesc: Canvas stroke width in CSS pixels.
settingsBindingsDesc: Enable or disable the four default bindings. Editing directions, adding new bindings, or recording custom gestures will arrive in a later stage.
settingsExportDesc: Download the current configuration as a JSON file.
settingsImportDesc: Replace the current configuration from a JSON file. The import is validated before being applied.
settingsResetDesc: Reset every field and binding to its default value.
settingsResetConfirm: Restore all settings to their defaults? This cannot be undone.
